name: OneLane
pitch: Let cooperating apps take turns using one Tiiny.
description: A Python library providing shared file locks, busy retries and optional model-budget tracking. Copy onelane.py into your application; there is no app to start. Release pending: upstream declares no version and has no local release tags, so 0.1.0 is a proposed first farm release, not an observed upstream version. Live release lookup was blocked; size 0 means unknown. Farm uses Python 3.11; upstream does not state a minimum.
